title: Constrain file paths to an approved base directory
summary: File names and paths influenced by untrusted input must be normalized and verified to remain within an approved storage boundary.
review_checks: Find file reads, writes, archives, and path joins using request or user values.
Confirm canonicalized paths are checked against a fixed base directory.
safe_tests: Use a temporary local directory and test nested, absolute, and traversal-like path inputs.
Confirm attempts outside the temporary base are rejected.
remediation: Use generated server-side identifiers for stored files.
Resolve paths and enforce containment before accessing the filesystem.
